newsitem.title: UK: Wedderburn seeks to buy Forspur oil producer.
newsitem.headline: Wedderburn seeks to buy Forspur oil producer.

text.p: Wedderburn Securities Plc said on Tuesday it had made an offer to acquire Forspur Trading Limited, an Cypriot-based oil trading and production company for a price calculated on the basis of Forspur's recoverable oil reserves.
Forspur owns substantial oil interests in Kazakhstan and the offer price will be payable in Wedderburn shares at 40p per share, Wedderburn said.
Wedderburn is quoted on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM).

Wedderburn said the offer is subject to extensive due diligence to be conducted by an independent oil expert, nominated by Wedderburn, on the proven and recoverable oil reserves, current product licences and other agreements.
"Additionally, the usual financial enquiries will be undertaken to satisfy Wedderburn, inter alia, that Forspur has cash resources of not less that $1 million," it said.
A further announcement will be made when the due diligence has been completed. An agreement to acquire Forspur, if concluded would be subject to shareholders' approval.
